1. On 28.01.2025 following order was passed: ‘Learned Additional Advocate General, Haryana, at the outset, submits that proviso added to Clause 6 of the Haryana Targeted Public Distribution System (Licensing and Control) Order, 2022, vide notification dated August 1, 2022, is being assailed, as it restricts the renewal of the licence for Fair Price Shop Owners beyond the age of 60 years. He submits that albeit a formal response on behalf of the State has been filed, but the matter is being re-considered by the competent authority and is at an advance stage. Accordingly, he prays for a short accommodation to apprise the Court of any further development. As prayed, adjourned to 08.07.2025. A photocopy of this order be placed on the files of the other connected cases.’

2. In pursuance to the said order, a letter dated 10.11.2025, addressed to the Advocate General, Haryana, by the Department of District Food and Supplies Controller, (PDS), for Director, Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs, Haryana, Chandigarh, has been placed before this Court wherein it has been mentioned that the Department has already proposed the REEMA SAINI : . 2025.11.13 amendment to the impugned proviso of clause-6 of the Haryana Targeted I High Court, Chandigarh CWP No.20398 of 2022 (O&M) and other connected cases -6Public Distribution System (Licensing and Control) Order, 2022, whereby restriction has been put by restricting renewal of the Fair Price Shop License in case the dealer had crossed the age of 60 years so as to delete the same . The letter further states that after the final approval by the Competent Authority, the action will be taken.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submit that keeping in view the statement given, that the matter is already being re-considered and the remedial steps are already being taken, the present petitions may kindly be disposed of having been not pressed any further.

4. As the grievance which has been raised by the petitioners is already been re-considered by the State and the remedial measure have already been initiated though such remedial measures have to reach to right conclusion, the present petitions are disposed of with the observations that the said process initiated by the State qua amendment of 2022 order should be finalized within a period of three months of the receipt of copy of this order and till then the Proviso to Clause 6(1) of the Haryana Targeted Public Distribution System (Licensing and Control) Order, 2022, will not be given effect to.

5. Pending application(s), if any, stands disposed of.

6. Photocopy of this order be placed on the files of other connected cases. (HARSIMRAN SINGH SETHI) JUDGE 10" November, 2025 (VIKAS SURI) reema JUDGE REEMA SAINI Whether speaking/reasoned : Yes 2025.11.13 0: Lattest to the eEreeportable : No integrity of this document High Court, Chandigarh
